influences.name: David Lynch
influences.context: Their last album, 2019's Careful, was a darkwave manifesto that could have easily soundtracked Lost Highway's long, tense driving sequences. But instead of waiting for the next David Lynch film, Jae and Gus decided to direct their own.

influences.name: David Cronenberg
influences.context: When I was 18 I watched all of [Cronenberg's movies] together. His earlier films really defined this genre: the horrific transformation of one's body, which is what I was most interested in.

influences.name: Andrzej Żuławski
influences.context: And Possession by Andrzej Żuławski — what sticks with me is the character of Anna. She's presented as a villain, but she's totally my hero.

influences.name: Julia Ducournau
influences.context: JM: We'd love to do a score for Julia Ducournau. We watched Titane and were like, 'Oh my God, we want to be part of this world!'

influences.name: Jim Morrison
influences.context: JM: I call that my Jim Morrison moment. We knew at that point what the movie was, and we knew we needed something that had written-in catharsis. I was trying to do that '70s swagger. Jim Morrison, love him or hate him, is super confident.

influences.name: Profligate
influences.context: In the beginning I was really inspired by projects like Profligate and Delroy Edwards that could take club music and make it so raw and physical.

influences.name: Claire Denis
influences.context: She referenced Claire Denis' High Life as inspiration, which had just come out. We were both big fans.

influences.name: Sarah Kinlaw
influences.context: When I first saw your work, you were dancing in a project directed by Sarah Kinlaw. You were being directed, as opposed to directing.

influences.name: Hunter Hunt-Hendrix
influences.context: I just started rehearsals for a black metal opera. I'm one of the two people in it. So I was working on that project and the Rabit x Boy Harsher video at the same time... and then would go to a rehearsal with Hunter Hunt-Hendrix, who is directing the opera, and really enjoy it as: 'I feel invested in this. I feel I can have ideas, but it's not mine.'

influences.name: Eartheater
